entries.title: II Chronicles 8:1
segments:
CHAP. VIII. 
 
  Solomon's buildings, ver. 1-6.   His workmen and officers, ver. 7-10.   He settles his wife, ver. 11.   Fixes the method of the temple service, ver. 12-16.   His trade, ver. 17, 18.

entries.title: II Chronicles 8:11
segments: V. 11. The house-He built this house for her; because the ark was now in the house of David, which therefore ought to be kept pure and free from the very danger and appearance of pollution.

entries.title: II Chronicles 8:14
segments: V. 14.  Man of God-A prophet inspired by God in these matters, whose commands therefore are the commands of God.

entries.title: II Chronicles 8:16
segments: V. 16. Prepared-All the materials were procured, and in all points fitted and compleated before-hand.
